summary.intent: Get a status picture of the callisto repo (git, PRs, plans, Entire history), then move on to landing the unpushed v1 work (T01-T05, T11) as a clean stack.
summary.outcome: Produced a full status report and agreed on a 5-layer crate-based commit stack (model, manifests, graph, cli, docs/changesets), leaving tool settings out. Started committing the code layers, with only callisto-model and the pre_mode_tests.rs file confirmed modified so far; nothing pushed.

repo: Branch work/v1-implementation-stack has 4 local commits (T01, reject unchanged release PR heads, T11, polyglot model docs) ahead of origin/main, with no PR and nothing pushed.

Uncommitted work (about 83 files, 7.6k lines) spans T02-T05 and ten changesets; several files (version.rs, release.rs, lib.rs, runner.rs, cascade.rs, CLI e2e tests) mix hunks from multiple changesets, so a per-topic split needs hunk-level patch surgery.
Cargo.lock +368 lines (36 packages) comes from the new jsonschema 0.53 dev-dependency in callisto-cli, so it is legitimate to commit.
ROAD-TO-V1.md is stale: its baseline reads 8ef9aa5a4 and 'awaiting merge', and Stage 1 is moot because 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 already shipped.
Aggregate `just ci` hit a sandbox lock in cargo-deny, so V1-VERIFICATION.md only has component-wise passes (1,862 tests, Clippy, 93.45% coverage, 25 release-workflow cases).
The repo is public; .entire/settings.json had push_sessions flipped to true, which conflicts with the user's note that session transcripts stay private.
workflow: Stage files by explicit path rather than `git add -A` when the tree has tooling or settings edits that must stay out of commits.
Run cargo check after each crate layer and full `just ci` on the stack tip before pushing.
Use a dry-run merge to detect conflicts without touching the working tree.
Confirm with the user before pushing or choosing between commit-split strategies.

friction: Dirty tree mixed v1 work with unrelated Entire/Claude/Gemini tooling edits, including one that would publish session transcripts from a public repo.
Changeset hunks are interleaved across files, which makes a clean per-topic commit split costly.
Sandbox lock in cargo-deny prevented a single green `just ci` run.
Possible overlap between local T01 commit and #170 on main was not verified during the status pass.
open_items: Finish committing the remaining layers (graph, cli, docs/changesets) and run cargo check per layer.
Rebase onto current main and resolve the T01 vs #170 overlap.
Run full `just ci` on the stack tip, then push as a native `gh stack` after user confirmation.
Start Stages 3-5: D01 owner-contract checkpoint, T06-T09, T10 generated workflows, T12 onboarding integration.

Clean up the Sep 27 stash, stale origin branches (fix/native-resolution, fix/release-forge-lookup, fix/release-pr-verify-envelope, docs/spec-rewrite), and Entire issues (hooks out of date, legacy shadow branch, 174 unpushed checkpoints).
Leave .entire/settings.json, .claude/settings.json and .gemini/settings.json edits out of the stack and decide what to do with them separately.
